I farm only 5 mu, and at my age I will keep things simple, familiar, and low-risk. I have followed the wheat-maize system for many years, and with well irrigation I can manage both crops steadily without changing the structure. Since some family members work off-farm, I will not choose anything too labor-intensive or experimental. For wheat, I will use improved seed, apply moderate fertilizer, irrigate a few key times, and keep field operations straightforward with rotary tillage. For summer maize, I will use hybrid seed because I want stable production on limited land, and I will put a bit more nitrogen into maize than wheat. I will not overuse water or chemicals, but I will still protect yield with basic pest control and timely irrigation. My goal is reliable grain output, manageable labor, and stable income from the land I know best.
